items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Topics 53:1
items.html: (To the question) MA and BON of AK, which are the NHY of AK, rose as MAN to the upper AB and SAG and coupled Panim be Panim [face to face]. And they brought down the bottom Hey from the Einayim, and returned all of the AHP to their degree as at first. (p. 547, Item 4)
